transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I wanted to get us together to sort out the lift assignment for tomorrow morning. As we all know, we've got one ceiling lift available, and both Room 214 and Room 228 need assisted transfers. The Room 228 patient has been waiting since yesterday, and the Room 214 order just came in this afternoon. I'd like to hear from physical therapy and the unit nurse before I make the final assignment, as I normally do during our morning handoff. Can we start by discussing both patients' transfer needs and staffing availability?

transcript.text: Good morning, Morgan. Before we sort out the ceiling lift assignment, I want to let everyone know that a 500-pound-rated floor lift with its compatible sling is already staged on the Room 228 unit. The Room 228 patient's transfer plan requires two staff members, and I've already verified the equipment and staffing with the night charge nurse. So Room 228 has an alternate transfer option ready to go.
